full_page.content:
1933, May
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 110 Cont.
May John Aspenlighter - 69 of Prestin, Ont. seemingly possessed - fear- ful condition.
Mary Rivard of Wyandotte - 5 - Streptococcic ...
9th
David Baker - 49 - Stroke & enlarged heart - twice natural size - wife & 3 - away from sacraments - wife baptized Cath. but never raised as such ..... Better Today- 10th
Walter Wie - K - 49 - wife & 5 - one studying for holy priest-hood . Promises weekly Com. instead of every four months.
Grace ... Clancy - 19 - T.B.
John Butler - 8 - one of triplets - knocked down last Sunday after receiving Holy Communion - now in Rec. Hospital, Recognizes Mother Mrs. - 24 - diptheria - 3 children Mrs. Fr. Pl. - 72 - diabetis- terrible pain Richard Law
Page 111 May
Baby Lila Johnson - 7th mo. threatened mastoids Thomas O'Brien - 10 - mastoids threatened Ed. Mc.Grath Co. Henry Lawhoff - 65 - cancer of Stomach
16 Harold Selke - 20 - To-day - paralyzed and since operation 12 yrs. ago deformed - another operation feard - one leg 12 inches too long
Madeline Cobb - 13 - paralyzed - nonCath .- can not talk plain, has terrible temper.
David Baker - 49 - wife bitter presbiterian - went to confession & communion - improving.
Stork case brother & sister - 100,000 stolen in legacy - things hope- ful now
16 Thos O'Brien - 7 - threatened double mastoid
Martin Riddell - 7th - 22 - here from Northville for 3 days .....
